title: Greenwich Village Soho Little Italy/Paris Chinatown Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Learn about the impressive history, architecture, and artist enclave known as Soho. See all of the mainstream and boutique shops that make the neighborhood one of New York and America's most unique shopping experiences. Bask in the ambience of Chinatown and Little Italy, two of New York's most famous ethnic enclaves.

A feeling of “déjà vu” awaits you as you cross the historic district of Greenwich Village, which has served as the setting for numerous films and TV series. It is one of the most popular residential neighborhoods in Manhattan and is full of magnificent single-family homes!
